역대상 2:1.content: These are the sons of Israel; Reuben, Simeon, Levi, and Judah, Issachar, and Zebulun,

역대상 2:2.content: Dan, Joseph, and Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.

역대상 2:3.content: The sons of Judah; Er, and Onan, and Shelah: which three were born unto him of the daughter of Shua the Canaanitess. And Er, the firstborn of Judah, was evil in the sight of the Lord; and he slew him.

역대상 2:4.content: And Tamar his daughter in law bare him Pharez and Zerah. All the sons of Judah were five.

역대상 2:5.content: The sons of Pharez; Hezron, and Hamul.

역대상 2:6.content: And the sons of Zerah; Zimri, and Ethan, and Heman, and Calcol, and Dara: five of them in all.

역대상 2:7.content: And the sons of Carmi; Achar, the troubler of Israel, who transgressed in the thing accursed.

역대상 2:8.content: And the sons of Ethan; Azariah.

역대상 2:9.content: The sons also of Hezron, that were born unto him; Jerahmeel, and Ram, and Chelubai.

역대상 2:10.content: And Ram begat Amminadab; and Amminadab begat Nahshon, prince of the children of Judah;

역대상 2:11.content: And Nahshon begat Salma, and Salma begat Boaz,

역대상 2:12.content: And Boaz begat Obed, and Obed begat Jesse,

역대상 2:13.content: And Jesse begat his firstborn Eliab, and Abinadab the second, and Shimma the third,

역대상 2:14.content: Nethaneel the fourth, Raddai the fifth,

역대상 2:15.content: Ozem the sixth, David the seventh:

역대상 2:16.content: Whose sisters were Zeruiah, and Abigail. And the sons of Zeruiah; Abishai, and Joab, and Asahel, three.

역대상 2:17.content: And Abigail bare Amasa: and the father of Amasa was Jether the Ishmeelite.

역대상 2:18.content: And Caleb the son of Hezron begat children of Azubah his wife, and of Jerioth: her sons are these; Jesher, and Shobab, and Ardon.

역대상 2:19.content: And when Azubah was dead, Caleb took unto him Ephrath, which bare him Hur.

역대상 2:20.content: And Hur begat Uri, and Uri begat Bezaleel.

역대상 2:21.content: And afterward Hezron went in to the daughter of Machir the father of Gilead, whom he married when he was threescore years old; and she bare him Segub.

역대상 2:22.content: And Segub begat Jair, who had three and twenty cities in the land of Gilead.

역대상 2:23.content: And he took Geshur, and Aram, with the towns of Jair, from them, with Kenath, and the towns thereof, even threescore cities. All these belonged to the sons of Machir the father of Gilead.

역대상 2:24.content: And after that Hezron was dead in Caleb–ephratah, then Abiah Hezron’s wife bare him Ashur the father of Tekoa.

역대상 2:25.content: And the sons of Jerahmeel the firstborn of Hezron were, Ram the firstborn, and Bunah, and Oren, and Ozem, and Ahijah.

역대상 2:26.content: Jerahmeel had also another wife, whose name was Atarah; she was the mother of Onam.

역대상 2:27.content: And the sons of Ram the firstborn of Jerahmeel were, Maaz, and Jamin, and Eker.

역대상 2:28.content: And the sons of Onam were, Shammai, and Jada. And the sons of Shammai; Nadab, and Abishur.

역대상 2:29.content: And the name of the wife of Abishur was Abihail, and she bare him Ahban, and Molid.

역대상 2:30.content: And the sons of Nadab; Seled, and Appaim: but Seled died without children.

역대상 2:31.content: And the sons of Appaim; Ishi. And the sons of Ishi; Sheshan. And the children of Sheshan; Ahlai.

역대상 2:32.content: And the sons of Jada the brother of Shammai; Jether, and Jonathan: and Jether died without children.

역대상 2:33.content: And the sons of Jonathan; Peleth, and Zaza. These were the sons of Jerahmeel.

역대상 2:34.content: Now Sheshan had no sons, but daughters. And Sheshan had a servant, an Egyptian, whose name was Jarha.

역대상 2:35.content: And Sheshan gave his daughter to Jarha his servant to wife; and she bare him Attai.

역대상 2:36.content: And Attai begat Nathan, and Nathan begat Zabad,

역대상 2:37.content: And Zabad begat Ephlal, and Ephlal begat Obed,

역대상 2:38.content: And Obed begat Jehu, and Jehu begat Azariah,

역대상 2:39.content: And Azariah begat Helez, and Helez begat Eleasah,

역대상 2:40.content: And Eleasah begat Sisamai, and Sisamai begat Shallum,

역대상 2:41.content: And Shallum begat Jekamiah, and Jekamiah begat Elishama.

역대상 2:42.content: Now the sons of Caleb the brother of Jerahmeel were, Mesha his firstborn, which was the father of Ziph; and the sons of Mareshah the father of Hebron.

역대상 2:43.content: And the sons of Hebron; Korah, and Tappuah, and Rekem, and Shema.

역대상 2:44.content: And Shema begat Raham, the father of Jorkoam: and Rekem begat Shammai.

역대상 2:45.content: And the son of Shammai was Maon: and Maon was the father of Beth–zur.

역대상 2:46.content: And Ephah, Caleb’s concubine, bare Haran, and Moza, and Gazez: and Haran begat Gazez.

역대상 2:47.content: And the sons of Jahdai; Regem, and Jotham, and Geshan, and Pelet, and Ephah, and Shaaph.

역대상 2:48.content: Maachah, Caleb’s concubine, bare Sheber, and Tirhanah.

역대상 2:49.content: She bare also Shaaph the father of Madmannah, Sheva the father of Machbenah, and the father of Gibea: and the daughter of Caleb was Achsah.

역대상 2:50.content: These were the sons of Caleb the son of Hur, the firstborn of Ephratah; Shobal the father of Kirjath–jearim,

역대상 2:51.content: Salma the father of Beth–lehem, Hareph the father of Beth–gader.

역대상 2:52.content: And Shobal the father of Kirjath–jearim had sons; Haroeh, and half of the Manahethites.

역대상 2:53.content: And the families of Kirjath–jearim; the Ithrites, and the Puhites, and the Shumathites, and the Mishraites; of them came the Zareathites, and the Eshtaulites.

역대상 2:54.content: The sons of Salma; Beth–lehem, and the Netophathites, Ataroth, the house of Joab, and half of the Manahethites, the Zorites.

역대상 2:55.content: And the families of the scribes which dwelt at Jabez; the Tirathites, the Shimeathites, and Suchathites. These are the Kenites that came of Hemath, the father of the house of Rechab.
